---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation you're experiencing:

- What currently doesn't work or is difficult to achieve?
- Which role(s) does it involve, or is it a new role?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented:

- What should the new behavior be?
- New variables? Defaults? Platform coverage?

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered alternatives?

- Does `startcloud.startcloud_roles` already cover this? (Check first — we
  don't duplicate roles that exist there.)
- What workarounds have you tried?

## Impact Assessment

- [ ] Critical (essential for provisioning)
- [ ] High (significantly improves functionality)
- [ ] Medium (useful improvement)
- [ ] Low (nice to have)

## Community Support

- [ ] I would be willing to help implement this feature
- [ ] I would be willing to test this feature
- [ ] I'm primarily requesting and hoping others implement it

## Additional Context

Add any other context or references about the feature request here.
